description.value:
The photographs were explicit and damning.
Marcos Santana was right: no one would believe that he and Sharley had not been having an affair - the pictures said it all.
Sharley knew there was good reason for the blackmail. The labor disputes in Marcos's Portuguese vineyards and the merger with her Godfather's English Corp. would blow up if the pictures were released.
There was no alternative but to destroy the photograph's scandal value. They must get married-quickly! The marriage would be in name only, but would Marcos's girlfriend, Teresa understand that? Would Marcos...?

/books/OL38395029M.title: Stormy Springtime and the Bachelor's Wedding

/books/OL24942951M.description:
A marriage based on convenience -- or on love?

When fragile Emelia awoke from her coma she had no recollection of the strikingly handsome man before her, whose eyes glittered like fine-cut gems -- hard and impenetrable. But he aroused something within her....

Javier Melendez had wed Emelia for convenience and bedded her for pleasure. The rules in place during their marriage had suited him perfectly, and he'd ensured his trophy wife adhered to them.... But as Emelia's memory slowly returned, she seemed to be laboring under a misapprehension...that their marriage was based on love!
/books/OL24942951M.title: The Melendez Forgotten Marriage

first_sentence.value: EVEN before Emelia opened her eyes she knew she was in hospital. At the blurred edges of her consciousness she vaguely registered the sound of shoes squeaking on polished linoleum and the swish of curtains and voices, both male and female, speaking in low hushed tones.

/books/OL10241285M.description:
Her lover -- until her memory returns?

When Anna woke up in hospital, the first person she saw was Ward Hunter. The chemistry between them was so intense, Anna was convinced he must be her lover! 

Ward found Anna's sensuality hard to resist -- but was she the woman who had defrauded his brother? Ward fell for Anna anyway, though when she regained her memory would she feel betrayed... that Ward had become her lover by deception?
/books/OL10241285M.title: Lover by Deception
